tools.name: screen_sanctions
tools.description: Screen a person or organisation against the UK, UN, EU and US OFAC sanctions lists, refreshed daily from the official sources. Returns possible matches with a score and the listing, and names every list screened with its date. Paid per call from your Stratum API balance, or use a test key.

tools.name: screen_export_controls
tools.description: Screen a buyer, consignee or supplier against six US export-control lists (including the Entity List) and the UK, UN, EU and OFAC sanctions lists. Paid per call from your Stratum API balance, or use a test key.

tools.name: company_profile
tools.description: The Companies House record for a UK company: its details, its active officers and warning flags. Paid per call from your Stratum API balance, or use a test key.

tools.name: company_owners
tools.description: Who owns and controls a UK company: the people with significant control, walked up through any corporate owners, with the ultimate beneficial owners worked out. Paid per call from your Stratum API balance, or use a test key.

tools.name: company_risk_score
tools.description: A risk score for a UK company with the factors behind it (overdue accounts, charges, officer turnover, insolvency history, company age and status). Paid per call from your Stratum API balance, or use a test key.

tools.name: fca_search_firms
tools.description: Search the FCA Financial Services Register by firm name. Returns matching firms with their FRN and status. Paid per call from your Stratum API balance, or use a test key.

tools.name: fca_firm
tools.description: A firm on the FCA register by its FRN: authorisation status, addresses, and whether it appears on the FCA Warning List. Paid per call from your Stratum API balance, or use a test key.

tools.name: postcode_report
tools.description: Flood risk, crime, deprivation, coal mining, radon, contaminated land and Japanese knotweed records for a UK postcode. Paid per call from your Stratum API balance, or use a test key.

tools.name: epc_for_address
tools.description: The latest EPC for a property, with the rating and whether it meets the minimum energy standard for letting (MEES). Paid per call from your Stratum API balance, or use a test key.

tools.name: run_suite_check
tools.description: Runs a whole job in one call and issues one signed certificate: a letting (tenant, landlord, guarantor), a sale (buyer, seller), a finance client (client, director, counterparty) or an export shipment (buyer, consignee, endUser, intermediateConsignee, forwarder, supplier, with a destination). tools.name: sanctions_lists
tools.description: The sanctions lists Stratum screens against, how many entries each has and when each was last refreshed. Free with any key that can screen.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "screen_sanctions" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
